function.name: archive_documents
function.description: Archives a list of documents based on document IDs and an optional expiration date for archival. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

document_ids.description: A list of unique identifier strings for the documents to be archived.

expire_date.description: The expiration date for the archival in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'. If not provided, defaults to 'null' which implies no expiration.

notify_user.description: Flag indicating whether to notify the user upon successful archival. Defaults to false.

Shashi Tej Reddy is an Indian entrepreneur and philanthropist best known for his work in the technology and education sectors. He founded **TechBridge Solutions**, a company that provides IT consulting services to small and medium enterprises across India. Under his leadership, TechBridge has grown from a modest startup into a regional player with offices in Hyderabad, Bangalore, and Chennai.

Beyond his business ventures, Reddy is actively involved in community development. He established the **Reddy Foundation**, which focuses on improving digital literacy among underprivileged children in rural areas. The foundation runs free coding camps and provides scholarships for students pursuing STEM degrees.

He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science from Osmania University and an MBA from the Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Ahmedabad. Reddy frequently speaks at industry conferences and is recognized for his advocacy of inclusive growth in the tech ecosystem.
